# FDG3068

> DO name collection properties with a plural phrase describing the items in the collection instead of using a singular phrase followed by “List” or “Collection.”

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.6.2 Names of Properties.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

planned-analyzer: collection properties named with a List or Collection suffix.

## From the book

```csharp
public class ListView {
  // good naming
  public ItemCollection Items { get; }

  // bad naming
  public ItemCollection ItemCollection { get; }
}
```
